selection_process: Selection for these posts follows a multi-stage process combining a physical efficiency test, a written exam, and (for driver posts) a trade test. || Application scrutiny:Only candidates meeting all eligibility conditions are permitted to the physical efficiency test stage. || Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - completed:Conducted by the department for the 7 non-Station-Officer posts, out of 100 marks; General category candidates required a minimum of 50 marks, SC/ST/OBC candidates a minimum of 40 marks. Qualifying marks: General category - 40, SC/ST/OBC - 30. || Trade Test (Driver / Driver-cum-Operator only):An additional 100-mark trade test; General category minimum 50 marks, SC/ST/OBC minimum 40 marks. || Bonus marks:Up to 5 marks each (maximum 10 marks total, even with more than two qualifications) for: (a) a Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence - not applicable for Driver/Driver-cum-Operator posts themselves, (b) national-level sports proficiency as a winner in a competition organised directly under the relevant national sports federation, and (c) an NCC 'C' certificate. || Final Merit List:Prepared based on the total of PET marks + Written Exam marks + Bonus marks (bonus calculated separately), category-wise, following reservation rules.
